newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight, one-week rates fall further.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight, one-week rates fall further.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell again on Thursday in a very liquid private sector market to between 9-1/2 and 10 percent from Wednesday's range of 9-3/4 to 10-1/8 percent, bankers said.
The market is traditionally liquid at the end of the week, but one banker described it as "extremely liquid."
One-week rates fell to 9-3/4 from Wednesday's range of 9-7/8 to 10-1/16 percent. "I even heard some asking for one-month at 10 percent," the banker said.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10-1/2 percent.
